description:
Comment style: plain present-tense facts, no ticket numbers. runtime/src/any_value.rs alone cites vrx.0.2 (TAG_LIST, TAG_MAP, TAG_STRUCT docs), fz-yan.1 (TAG_SPECIAL note and reserved atom ids), fz-s9y.2 (EMPTY_LIST_BITS), vrx.A.1 (ListCons), and procbin.rs cites fz-5xp.55. The same pattern is likely across runtime/src and src.

Done when: a census (grep for ticket-id patterns such as '\bfz-[a-z0-9]{2,4}(\.[0-9]+)*\b' and 'vrx\.' in comments under runtime/src and src) is recorded in the commit; each hit is rewritten to the fact it was carrying, or deleted when the code already says it; the grep over comments returns nothing. Identifiers, test names and fixture data that contain ids are reported, not renamed. Done when also: comments are plain present-tense facts with no ticket numbers; full gate green (cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace --all-targets --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=1; cargo test --workspace --doc); no pin or golden moves; commit in Why / What changed / Verification form; no co-author trailer, no attribution line.
title: Runtime comments state facts, not ticket numbers
